header.title: Technology Partners & Alliances
header.subtitle: Collaborating with industry leaders to deliver cutting-edge AI and technology solutions

aiPartners.name: OpenAI
aiPartners.description: Strategic partnership with OpenAI powers our platform with GPT-4, GPT-4 Turbo, and future models. We integrate cutting-edge language models for intelligent automation, code generation, and natural language processing at enterprise scale.

aiPartners.name: Anthropic
aiPartners.description: Claude AI integration brings superior analytical capabilities, 200K token context windows, and enhanced safety protocols. Perfect for complex enterprise applications requiring deep contextual understanding and ethical AI decision-making.

aiPartners.name: Cursor AI
aiPartners.description: Cursor AI partnership enhances developer productivity with intelligent code completion, refactoring, and pair programming capabilities. Built on GPT-4, Cursor transforms how developers write, review, and optimize code.

aiPartners.name: Apple
aiPartners.description: Apple ecosystem integration enables seamless deployment across macOS, iOS, and iPadOS. We leverage Apple Silicon's neural engine for on-device AI processing, ensuring privacy-first machine learning capabilities.

aiPartners.name: Microsoft
aiPartners.description: Microsoft Azure partnership provides enterprise-grade cloud infrastructure, Azure OpenAI Service, and comprehensive AI/ML tools. We integrate with Microsoft 365, Teams, and Power Platform for seamless enterprise workflows.

aiPartners.name: Meta
aiPartners.description: Meta's Llama 2 & Llama 3 models power our open-source AI solutions. We leverage Meta's PyTorch framework for custom model development and contribute to the open-source AI community through Meta's ecosystem.

aiPartners.name: Google
aiPartners.description: Google Cloud and Gemini AI partnership delivers multimodal capabilities, global infrastructure, and best-in-class search technology. We integrate Google Workspace, BigQuery analytics, and Vertex AI for comprehensive solutions.

content.name: OpenAI
content.description: Strategic partnership with OpenAI enables us to integrate GPT-4, GPT-4 Turbo, and future models into our platform. We leverage OpenAI's cutting-edge language models to power our AI agents, providing businesses with state-of-the-art natural language processing, code generation, and intelligent automation capabilities.

content.name: Anthropic
content.description: Partnership with Anthropic brings Claude AI to our platform, offering advanced reasoning capabilities, long-context understanding (200K tokens), and enhanced safety features. Claude's superior performance in complex analytical tasks makes it ideal for enterprise applications requiring deep contextual understanding.

content.name: Google Cloud & Gemini
content.description: Google Cloud partnership provides enterprise-grade infrastructure and Gemini AI capabilities. We leverage Google's multimodal AI, advanced search, and global cloud infrastructure to deliver high-performance, scalable solutions with best-in-class reliability and security.

content.name: Amazon Web Services (AWS)
content.description: AWS partnership enables us to deliver highly scalable, secure, and reliable cloud infrastructure. We leverage AWS's extensive service portfolio including EC2, Lambda, EKS (Kubernetes), RDS, and S3 to build resilient, enterprise-grade solutions. UK data residency in London region ensures GDPR compliance.

content.name: Kubernetes & CNCF
content.description: Kubernetes expertise and CNCF ecosystem integration enable us to deliver cloud-native, container-based solutions. We architect, deploy, and manage Kubernetes clusters for high-availability, auto-scaling applications. Our team holds CKA (Certified Kubernetes Administrator) certifications.

content.name: Elastic (ELK Stack)
content.description: Elastic partnership provides powerful log management, search, and observability solutions. We implement Elasticsearch, Logstash, and Kibana (ELK Stack) for real-time data analytics, application monitoring, and security event management. Our expertise includes large-scale deployments processing terabytes of data daily.

content.name: Dynatrace
content.description: Dynatrace partnership delivers AI-powered application performance monitoring and observability. We implement Dynatrace for comprehensive monitoring of cloud-native applications, microservices, and infrastructure. Our Dynatracers are experts in DQL, SIEM, synthetic monitoring, RUM, distributed traces, and troubleshooting.

content.name: MongoDB
content.description: MongoDB BigData NoSQL technology is perfect for large scale web applications where performance is key. We support and extend customer solutions — expanding business capabilities through big data & analytics. Our expertise includes replica sets, sharding, aggregation pipelines, and Atlas cloud database management.

content.name: Node.js Foundation
content.description: Node.js® is a JavaScript runtime built on Chrome's V8 JavaScript engine. Node.js uses an event-driven, non-blocking I/O model that makes it lightweight and efficient. We leverage Node.js' ecosystem, npm (the largest ecosystem of open source libraries), for building scalable, high-performance backend services and APIs.

content.name: Python Software Foundation
content.description: Python is a widely-used general-purpose scripting language that is especially suited for AI/ML, data science, web development, and automation. We leverage Python's extensive ecosystem including TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn, pandas, and FastAPI for building intelligent applications and data pipelines.

content.name: Adobe Technology Partner
content.description: Adobe Technology Partners sell, support, and extend Adobe products — providing solutions to expand creative and publishing capabilities. Our CatBase platform integrates seamlessly with Adobe InDesign, allowing automated catalog and publication production from databases.

content.name: 4D Database Solutions
content.description: 4D is a software organization which caters to the database needs of individuals, companies and Fortune 500 corporations. We have a longstanding relationship with 4D, leveraging their rapid application development platform for building custom business solutions and integrated database applications.

content.name: Tax and Figures
content.description: Tax and Figures is a leading accountancy practice based in Hemel Hempstead providing trusted advice to businesses and individuals. Our partnership provides comprehensive accounting, tax advisory, and financial compliance services to our clients, ensuring regulatory compliance and financial health.

content.name: Stripe
content.description: Stripe partnership enables secure, PCI DSS compliant payment processing for our CRM and e-commerce solutions. We integrate Stripe for subscriptions, invoicing, and payment gateway functionality, providing businesses with seamless payment acceptance across multiple currencies and payment methods.

content.name: Intercom
content.description: Intercom integration provides powerful customer communication, live chat, and support ticketing capabilities. We leverage Intercom for customer onboarding, engagement campaigns, and support automation, helping businesses provide exceptional customer experiences at scale.
